items.name: Julien Du Casse
items.where: In Great Inagua Manor, in the room with the weapon display cases.
items.gate: Needs story progress; collect after the story.

items.name: Laureano de Torres
items.where: Northwest tower of the castle in northeast Havana; climb in through the open window from above using the wooden boards.

items.name: El Tiburon
items.where: Inside the castle north of Havana; use the scaffold outside the corner to reach the open window. The in-game codex wrongly says Castillo.

items.name: Commodore Chamberlaine
items.where: Top floor of the manor in western Nassau, entered through a window.

items.name: Woodes Rogers
items.where: In a manor in central Kingston.

items.name: Laurens Prins
items.where: In the plantation manor in western Kingston.

items.name: Ben Hornigold
items.where: On a shipwreck in the northeast corner of Santanillas.
items.gate: No specific gate beyond story progress is given.

items.name: Bartholomew Roberts
items.where: Inside a tent in the northeast; use the P fast-travel icon on the world map and leave via the ship wheel.
items.gate: Region opens at Sequence 09 Mission 02, but the portrait only appears later in Sequence 12.

items.name: Blackbeard
items.region: Reward of side quest "Blackbeard's Treasure" (Anotto Bay, then Great Inagua)
items.where: Dive from a damaged diving bell at Anotto Bay to an underwater tunnel, blow up two walls with explosive barrels to reach the treasure, then take it from the chest at Great Inagua.

items.name: Stede Bonnet
items.region: Reward of side quest "Captain Stede Bonnet" (starts at Great Inagua; Mystery Island)
items.where: Go to the stranded schooner on Mystery Island and follow the crewmates through the marked objectives.

items.name: Robert Maynard
items.region: Reward of the "A World Without Gold" questline (Port Royal)
items.where: Portrait shows up in Port Royal below the central viewpoint once you reach "Maynard's Treasure".
items.gate: Questline starts after Sequence 11 Mission 03; it has 8 quests and the 4th needs Lucy Baldwin and The Padre recruited.

notes: Hanging all 11 in Great Inagua Manor unlocks the bronze trophy The Memory of My Enemy. The page says all 11 are needed, though one commenter got it without Maynard.
